value: Which regulatory programs differ in untreated (control) CD14+ monocytes relative to NK cells, per cohort, behind the cohort difference in Delta_ctrl (GSE96583 -0.72, HIRISA +4.83 on log2(CPM+1) of the 10-gene panel)

GSE96583 (cache/Kang18_8vs8.Rda; 8 SLE donors; mixed PBMC; 6 h; ctrl wells); HIRISA GSE306664 (cache/hirisa, analysis/independent_cohort/samples.tsv cond == ctrl, md5 per analysis/independent_cohort/downloads.tsv; 5 healthy donors; separated cells cultured 21 h); GSE226572 0h (cache/gse226572/selected_cells.rds; 3 healthy donors; mixed PBMC; both 0h libraries pooled; secondary, descriptive only)

GSE96583: rules of analysis/primary_contrast/scripts/01_quality_control.R (singlet, valid labels, cell in CD14+ Monocytes or NK cells, library > 0, >= 200 detected genes), stim == ctrl. HIRISA: mono files celltype.l2 == CD14 Mono, NK files celltype.l1 == NK, n_genes >= 200 (as 02_analysis.R). GSE226572: time == 0h, label CD14 Mono or NK (as 03_analysis.R)
sum counts per donor x lineage (analysis/shared/utils_estimation.R pseudobulk); genes keyed by gene symbol, symbols duplicated within a cohort dropped

per cohort over its control profiles only: edgeR filterByExpr with group = lineage, TMM, logCPM prior count 2 (logcpm_by_lineage applied to all control profiles of the cohort as one normalisation group)
per donor and gene: logCPM(control CD14+ mono) minus logCPM(control NK), over the expressed genes of that cohort

CollecTRI human via OmniPath (see network_source.tsv; md5 pinned). Signed mode of regulation: -1 if consensus_inhibition and not consensus_stimulation, else +1 (CollecTRI default activation). AP-1 (JUN/FOS) and NF-kB (REL/NFKB) complex sources collapsed to AP1 and NFKB as in decoupleR; duplicate TF-target pairs collapsed to the sign of the summed weights (ties +1)
the 10 panel genes of analysis/inputs/core_isgs.tsv are removed from every regulon before scoring
TFs with < 5 remaining targets among the cohort's expressed genes are excluded for that cohort; cohort differences reported only for TFs scored in both GSE96583 and HIRISA

univariate linear model (ULM, decoupleR): per donor, regress the gene statistic on the TF's signed weight vector (0 for non-targets) across expressed genes with intercept; TF activity = t-value of the slope
per cohort and TF: mean, sd, n of donor t-values; cohort difference = mean HIRISA minus mean GSE96583
pre-stated: STAT1, STAT2, IRF9 (ISGF3); IRF1, IRF7, IRF3; RELA, NFKB1, REL, NFKB (NF-kB). Plus top 10 TFs by absolute cohort difference, labelled post hoc ranking

ISGF3 supported: HIRISA minus GSE96583 > 2 t-units for all of STAT1, STAT2, IRF9 and for none of RELA, NFKB1, REL -> supports tonic type I IFN (ISGF3) signalling over inflammatory NF-kB activation as the source of the baseline difference. NF-kB supported: > 2 for all of RELA, NFKB1, REL and for none of STAT1, STAT2, IRF9 -> supports NF-kB activation. Both sets meet their all-three condition -> mixed. Otherwise -> not resolved

descriptive only, no inference; cohort is aliased with disease (SLE vs healthy), preparation (mixed PBMC vs separated cells), culture duration (6 h vs 21 h) and platform; CollecTRI regulons are literature-derived, not cell-type specific; TF activity is inferred from target transcripts, not TF protein or phosphorylation
